title: BOFT independent factors versus shared Mirror adapter bank
hypothesis: Butterfly-factorized orthogonal task transforms can encode aligned low-complexity task functions with far less state than independent BOFT banks; a shared butterfly basis plus small task coordinates should be tested against generic coefficient controls. Independent maps define where private factors become necessary.
mirror_coordinate: per-task butterfly layer angles on one shared plane schedule
controls: independent full OFT matrix upper control

development.allowed: validate butterfly orthogonality, fit recovery, payload serialization, MAC counts and runtime; choose factorization only before fresh

storage.authority: actual canonical serialized inference payload bytes
paid_objects: all learned butterfly factors or addresses

success_gate: Aligned Mirror/generic shared-basis code reaches NRMSE <=1e-4 and uses <=50% bytes of independent BOFT; runtime is reported separately.
failure_gate: Aligned reconstruction error >0.01, or <=20% byte saving at matched quality; no Mirror-specific claim if generic coefficients match.
amendments: Development audit found independent-task condition was initially represented by a dense oracle mislabeled as BOFT. Replaced it before fresh with support-fitted butterfly angles. Slow Python searches were interrupted before fresh; finalized a fixed 30-step scalar fit and one bounded coordinate pass with three candidates per factor angle. Full OFT remains an oracle upper.
boundaries: No NLP or vision quality claim
BOFT is established prior art; butterfly factorization itself is not a Mirror novelty claim
